title: SEC-01 Central Execution-Policy Runtime Gate
purpose: Enforce Locaily's central execution-security boundary at runtime ('models may propose actions; Locaily decides whether they execute') using policies/default-execution-policy.json, action-request.schema.json, and policy-decision.schema.json before enabling any write, shell, or network capabilities in Workflow Packs or tools.
problem: docs/security/* and policies/default-execution-policy.json currently define a design-only policy boundary; filesystem, shell, network, credential, and NearbyNode actions are not yet routed through a fail-closed central runtime decision engine with human approval gates and audit trails.

excluded: Auto-approving arbitrary shell commands or credential reads
Enabling external network writes by default

acceptanceCriteria.description: Fail-closed runtime policy engine evaluating action-request.schema.json against policies/default-execution-policy.json (defaultDecision: 'deny', emitting policy-decision.schema.json decisions: allow, require_approval, deny).
evidence: scripts/test-sec01-execution-policy-gate.js AC1 & AC4 (verified schema validation, fail-closed unknown/prototype/invalid requests, workspace-escape/credential/config escalation)

acceptanceCriteria.description: Enforcement hooks wrapping filesystem, shell, network, credential, and NearbyNode tool and Workflow Pack execution paths with explicit decision codes and audit events (zero bypasses).
evidence: Clean-server smoke-test.js 61/61, test:jobs:production 8/8, test:relay:e2e 11/11, npm run test:full 28/28 suites passed

acceptanceCriteria.description: Human-in-the-loop approval flow (API + Companion Console UI surface) for require_approval actions while preserving hard deny for shell.execute.arbitrary, credentials.read, audit.disable, and policy.modify.runtime.
evidence: companion/console/{index.html,app.js,styles.css} (#navSecurityLink, #securityView, approval queue controls, interactive policy evaluator)

acceptanceCriteria.description: NOPE evaluation decision (docs/security/NOPE-EVALUATION.md) recorded in docs/06-decisions/decision-log.md and comprehensive positive/negative security test suite wired into npm run test:full.
evidence: docs/security/NOPE-EVALUATION.md & docs/06-decisions/decision-log.md (native zero-dependency evaluator behind pluggable adapter)
scripts/test-sec01-execution-policy-gate.js (7/7 passed) wired as package.json test:execution-policy and inside test:full
